releases.title: Canvas navigation and frame workflows
notes: Move Back and Forward through bounded camera history with Option-Command-Left/Right. Finding a selection centers its current animated position without changing artwork.
Control existing top-level frame and section names independently with persistent View settings.
Insert searchable Watch, Paper and Presentation frame presets from Assets.
Swap a frame orientation, select its visible unlocked direct children, or fit a supported free-layout frame while keeping child artwork in place. Undo and saved files retain supported frame edits.
Refuse overflowing frame-fit geometry before changing the document.
limits: This is a development preview. Current installer metadata and checksums are published on the Forma website.
Name toggles cover existing top-level labels. Nested container labels remain unfinished.
Fit uses direct child rectangular bounds without stroke/effect padding and refuses managed, motion, generated and auto-layout contexts.
Substantial Figma parity remains unfinished, including binary .fig export and cloud collaboration.

releases.title: Offline Figma Design import
notes: Open supported local binary .fig Design files in the browser or Mac app, without uploading the source file.
Preserve supported page/layer geometry, embedded images and original glyph shapes while keeping text editable. Review any feature reductions after import.
Import component instances as detached editable layers. Native annotation blocks can retain their own embedded visual snapshots.
Imported Mac files start as new unsaved projects. Save a .oui copy; the Figma source is never a save destination.
Cancel obsolete imports before they can replace current edits or the active recovery identity.
limits: This is a development preview. Current installer metadata and checksums are published on the Forma website.
Binary .fig import supports a documented subset of Design files. Live component linkage, native rich annotation editing, complete prototype/layout semantics and full visual parity are not promised.
Binary .fig export and substantial Figma suite parity remain unfinished.

releases.title: Pages, local layouts and image clipboard
notes: Duplicate, reorder and search pages with contextual and keyboard actions; shared component links stay intact and unsafe deletion is refused.
Remember each Design/Whiteboard page's pan and zoom locally, and preview its static artwork on hover or keyboard focus.
Paste bounded PNG/TIFF image data into the Mac canvas, including the active slide. Copy as PNG creates a transparent 2× selection snapshot.
Follow system light/dark appearance, or retain an explicit interface theme.
Saved-file MCP adds atomic page duplication and reordering. Browser startup waits for recovery before editing or autosave.
Move supported complete layer trees between pages with stable identities and live component links; unsafe contextual cases are refused.
Add a plain-text project description through File information, with Undo and saved-file MCP metadata reads.
Collapse and resize layers/properties sidebars with pointer or keyboard controls; local layout stays outside project files.
Browse bundled release notes from Help, with development/preview labels and public download checksums.
Open registered local file actions from the document-title menu, with keyboard navigation and focus return.
Follow system reduced-motion preferences for editor chrome, with a local override; deliberate authored animation and exports retain their settings.
Identify mask sources, modes and nearest affected artwork in the layer tree with bounded accessible descriptions.
limits: This is a development preview with documented limits. Current installer metadata and checksums are published on the Forma website.
Browser/Windows system-image clipboard and private Figma editable clipboard remain unfinished.
Substantial Figma suite parity remains unfinished, including binary .fig interchange and cloud collaboration.

releases.title: Native editable clipboard and canvas backgrounds
notes: Transfer editable Forma layers between Mac document windows, with validated component/style/variable/font dependencies and one-step Undo.
Edit page canvas color, opacity and visibility; use an explicit color-pair contrast checker.
Use the local vector, typography, layout, components, variables, prototype, whiteboard, Slides and motion workspaces.
limits: This Mac preview is earlier than the current development source and has documented feature limits.
The app and DMG were Developer ID signed, notarized, stapled and Gatekeeper checked. The universal binary includes Intel; Intel runtime validation is pending.
Keep .oui projects and backups when upgrading. There is no silent updater.
